cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Concrete traps it halfway across the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.

mechanism: A corrects a surveyor's practical intervention through a migration theory and recruits B to redirect the supposed house journey.
confusable: D150 seeks a rule; D151 recruits shared use of A's impossible explanation as the useful basis for action.
comparison: A household repair becomes route planning, unlike labor negotiation with an office kettle.
seedUse: Keep surveyor, concrete and truck as practical contributions A can reinterpret under claimed expert management.
